01 · the actual letter

A LITTLE THANK YOU TO AN AWESOME FRIEND ♡

Warning: this is a longer letter. No skipping paragraphs — the birthday committee has eyes everywhere.

First of all, HAPPY BIRTHDAY, SUMAIYA! 🥳🎂❤️

I wanted to make you something a little different — not just a birthday wish, but a small collection of appreciation, laughter, memories, and the random madness that makes our friendship so much fun.

You're honestly one of those people who can turn an ordinary day into an adventure. You have your own style, your own opinions, and a very impressive ability to make sure the world knows exactly what you think. 😂 Sometimes your “meto apne maan ka karungi” attitude deserves its own award, but that's also part of what makes you so wonderfully you.

And yes, I am still going to tease you because what kind of friend would I be if I suddenly became serious and sensible? That would be suspicious. But jokes aside, you genuinely have a beautiful smile, a strong presence, and a personality that people remember. I hope you never forget how lovely you are, both inside and out. 💜

Jokes apart, there's something I genuinely want you to know: THANK YOU FOR BEING MY FRIEND. ❤️ Thank you for being someone with whom I can be myself without constantly worrying about being judged. Thank you for listening to my nonsense, tolerating my weirdness, and never making me feel like I need to pretend to be someone else just to fit in.

I know I'm not always the most attentive friend. Sometimes I might not be as supportive as you need, sometimes I might not understand things immediately, and sometimes I get caught up in my own world. I know there may have been moments when you needed more from me than I was able to give. But despite all that, you've continued being a good friend, and I genuinely appreciate that more than I probably express. I don't take your friendship for granted.

And honestly, one of the things I appreciate most about you is that you're almost always ready for the simplest yet best plans. Want to randomly plan a trip? YES. Want to explore somewhere new? ABSOLUTELY YES. Want to roam around for the entire day without knowing where we're going or when we'll return? Somehow, you're already ready! 😂

I mean, seriously, how convenient is it to have a friend who doesn't need a 15-day advance notice just to have some fun? You don't need a perfect itinerary, a five-star plan, or even a clear destination. Sometimes all it takes is one random message saying “Let's go somewhere,” and the adventure begins.

Thank you for never making me feel weird about suggesting random plans, exploring new places, or simply deciding to spend an entire day wandering around. Sometimes the best memories aren't made during perfectly planned trips; they're made during those unplanned moments, random conversations, unnecessary laughter, endless roaming, unexpected stops, and the little detours that somehow become the best part of the day.

And that's something I genuinely enjoy about our friendship. I hope we never lose that adventurous side of ours. I hope we continue discovering new places, trying new food, making ridiculous plans, getting lost somewhere, taking random pictures, and collecting stories that we'll laugh about years later. There are still so many places to see, so many dishes to try, and so many “bas ek jagah chalte hain” plans waiting to happen.

Also, a small request: please don't ever become too busy or too sophisticated for our random plans. That's an important friendship responsibility, and I expect you to maintain your standards. And please take care of yourself — consider it my official birthday request. 😂

Beyond all the jokes, I genuinely admire your strength. You're a warrior in your own way: bold, fearless, outspoken, and determined to do things your way. You have that baddie energy that can dominate a room, that “meto apne maan ka karungi” attitude, and a confidence that refuses to quietly disappear. Never lose the courage to stand up for yourself. Just remember that you don't have to fight every single person or situation — sometimes peace is also a power move. 😂

I love that you're always ready to explore, that you can be chaotic and dramatic, and that you bring your own energy wherever you go. Life would be a little less entertaining without your random dialogues, your legendary threats, and your ability to turn a normal conversation into a full episode.

For your birthday, I wish you a life full of happiness, crazy adventures, unexpected opportunities, peaceful days, good health, and people who make you feel appreciated. May you achieve everything you're secretly dreaming about. May you laugh until your stomach hurts, travel to beautiful places, eat all your favourite food, and never lose that little spark that makes you YOU.

I hope this year brings you more reasons to be proud of yourself, more moments where you feel loved, and more days when you look back and think, “That was a beautiful day.” And whenever life gets a little complicated, I hope you remember that there are still countless places to explore, new memories to create, and plenty of beautiful moments to collect.

Thank you for being you. Thank you for being a good friend. And thank you for being my always-ready-to-explore partner.

Here's to more trips, more laughter, more ridiculous conversations, and many more memories together! 💜

With lots of appreciation (and unlimited teasing),
A friend ♡

02 · appreciation, with a little roasting

10 Things I Love About You 💜

A carefully researched list by someone who has survived your attitude, your drama, and your random plans.

You're genuinely one of the strongest people I know. You have this warrior spirit that refuses to give up easily. No matter what comes your way, you somehow manage to stand tall. Although sometimes I wonder whether you're fighting life's problems or starting a war with them. 😂
You have that main-character energy. You walk into a situation like you own the place, and sometimes I genuinely think the surroundings need permission from YOU to function. Confidence level: 1000%. Humility: still under investigation. 🤣
“Gand maar lungi uski!” Honestly, I don't think motivational speakers can compete with this level of confidence. Whenever you want to describe your bravery, you don't need a speech. Just one dialogue, and apparently the entire world needs to step aside. 😂
One thing I really appreciate about you is how you're always ready to explore. Random destinations, unplanned trips, endless roaming, and discovering new places. You don't need a perfect plan; you just need someone to say, “Let's go somewhere!”
You are chaos in human form. One minute everything is normal, and the next minute there's a whole new episode of your personal drama series. Honestly, life would be a little too boring without your unnecessary plot twists.
You don't simply experience situations; you PRODUCE them. A small inconvenience becomes a three-season Netflix series, complete with emotions, background music, and unexpected twists. And somehow, you're always the lead actress.
Advice? Optional. Suggestions? Ignored. Other people's opinions? Under consideration, but probably rejected. You have already decided what you're going to do, and the rest of the world is just receiving the announcement. Iconic behaviour, honestly.
I genuinely admire how you aren't afraid to speak your mind. You stand up for yourself, express what you feel, and don't easily let people push you around. Sometimes you might need to lower the volume a little, but never lose that confidence.
I like that you don't always try to be someone else just to impress people. You're weird, unpredictable, outspoken, occasionally impossible to handle, but genuinely yourself. And that's something worth appreciating.
Behind the warrior, the baddie, the drama queen, and the walking disaster, there's a person with a good heart who deserves happiness, respect, love, and beautiful experiences. I hope you never forget how special you are.
